title: Effect of High-Temperature Annealing on Raman Characteristics of Silicon Nanowire Arrays
raman_evidence: Fig. 5b (PDF p.6): spectrum of a monocrystalline Si reference with printed labels 302.06, 520.05 and 964.48 cm-1; text (PDF p.7): sharp symmetric first-order peak of monocrystalline silicon at 520.05 cm-1 (triply degenerate Gamma25 optical phonon) and two very weak broad peaks at 302.06 and 964.48 cm-1; Table 1 (PDF p.11) FWHM of the TO peak of four SiNW samples (8.6-19.9 cm-1, not of the wafer)
sample_description: Monocrystalline Si reference measured with HORIBA XploRA PLUS, plus ordered/disordered Si nanowire arrays made by metal-assisted chemical etching, before and after annealing
notes: Open access (MDPI, CC BY); the only open paper found that prints measured Si first-order and both second-order positions together. LABEL TRAP: the text calls 302.06 cm-1 '2TO' and 964.48 cm-1 '2TA' (reversed); by frequency 302 is the 2TA band and 964 the 2TO band, the usual assignment. No wafer FWHM is given. The sample is a lab Si reference, so the 520.05 value carries the instrument calibration of that spectrometer.
